\section{Literature Overview}

\begin{itemize}

\item * Attention Is All You Need \cite{Vaswani2017Attention}:
Introduces the Transformer architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms,
replacing recurrent and convolutional networks for sequence modelling tasks.

\item * BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers \cite{Devlin2018BERT}:
Presents BERT, a deeply bidirectional language representation model trained on
unlabelled text using masked language modelling and next sentence prediction.

\item * Language Models are Few-Shot Learners \cite{Brown2020GPT3}:
Demonstrates that scaling language models substantially improves task-agnostic,
few-shot performance, introducing GPT-3 with 175 billion parameters.

\item * NoMatchingBibEntry \cite{MissingKey2026}:
This entry deliberately has no matching BibTeX record and should be skipped.

\end{itemize}
